mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.5% in the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.2% within the last month signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and boosts consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE decreased by more than 0.2% in the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts over the last two months indicates a strong demand for housing, which is a leading indicator of economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the periods with sustained increases in housing starts.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 1% over the last two months signals increased economic activity and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of the instances where INDPRO increased by more than 1% in the previous two months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 4% and the consumer price index increases by more than 0.5% in a month, it signals inflationary pressure and tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL increase > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate decreases by more than 0.1% in the same month, it signals a strong labor market and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increase > 200k and UNRATE decrease > 0.1% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real personal consumption expenditures by more than 1% over the last month signals a weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of the instances where RSAFS decreased by more than 1% in the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP growth is negative for two consecutive quarters, it signals an economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where GDP growth was negative for two consecutive quarters.
